text: Scientists just found what's blocking the holy grail of electricity.
Do you know what happens if wires stop wasting power?
Right now, about five percent of America's electricity is lost... just traveling through power lines.
Superconductors fix that. Zero resistance. Zero waste.
The problem? Most only work at minus two hundred sixty degrees Celsius.
Now scientists in Europe built a brand new measuring tool...
and found the electron pairs that carry the current... survive at room temperature.
The pairs are there. They just don't move together. Like a crowd with no rhythm.
Get them in sync... and room-temperature superconductors might finally happen.
Power lines with zero waste. Floating trains. Cheaper MRI machines. Faster quantum computers.
It's not solved yet. But for the first time, scientists know exactly where to look.
Would this change the world more than AI?
